statusGuide.implemented_pending_deployment: Source and targeted regression checks exist; installation/live verification not yet asserted.

statusGuide.planned: Requested or documented unfinished work; no implementation/delivery claim.

statusGuide.fixture_only: Available only as an offline test/design fixture; production enablement is not claimed.
statusGuide.needs_design: Scope or authority contract needs design before implementation.
statusGuide.installed_pending_live_verification: Signed source is installed and its code/state checks passed; final authenticated production browser comparison is still pending.
statusGuide.source_candidate: Implemented source under review; not a claim of installation or owner acceptance.
statusGuide.verified_from_main: Merged source was checked through the documented coding workflow; this does not imply a production runtime deployment or owner acceptance.
